Placemaker.Roads.Name: Roads
Placemaker.Roads.Control.pattern.Tooltip: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.grid.Too: Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.tree.Too: A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed.To: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.loop.Too: Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.superblo: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.concentr: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.pattern.radial.T: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetAsset.Too: The road used for ordinary streets and the perimeter road. Automatic picks a small two-lane road.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.localAsset.Tool: Road used for cul-de-sacs and local streets. Automatic picks a small residential road.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueAsset.Too: Road used for avenues and collectors.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutAsset: Road used for roundabout rings (usually a one-way road).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.pathAsset.Toolt: Pedestrian street or path used inside superblocks.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.angle.Tooltip: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.alignTerrain.To: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridMode.Toolti: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.gridMode.count.T: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridColumns.Too: Number of streets across the area's length.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.gridRows.Toolti: Number of streets across the area's width.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.Toolt: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacFrequen: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacDepth.T: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.culDeSacStagger: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.capStyle.Toolti: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.grass.T: Turning circle with a grass island.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capStyle.trees.T: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.capSize.Tooltip: Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.capSize.xl.Toolt: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueColumn.To: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueRow.Toolt: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueIndex.Too: Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutIslan: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeBranchSpaci: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSacSpa: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loops.Tooltip: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.variation.Toolt: Another random layout with the same settings.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.contourLinkSpac: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenues.Tooltip: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.loopCollectorSp: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
Size of each block inside a superblock.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.rings.Tooltip: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.concentricConne: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.roundaboutRadiu: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterRoad.T: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
Placemaker.Roads.Option.perimeterRoad.au: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.perimeterCorner: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.connectExisting: Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.followTerrain.T: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.edgeDepth.Toolt: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetGrass.Too: Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
Placemaker.Roads.Control.streetBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueTrees.Too: Trees along both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueGrass.Too: Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Control.avenueBikeLanes: Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.NothingFits: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.ObstaclesAvoided: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.GenerationFailed: The streets could not be planned: {0}
Placemaker.Roads.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid.
Placemaker.Recipe.Roads.Description: A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithParks.Descrip: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
Placemaker.Recipe.RoadsWithZoning.Descri: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Name: Edge zoning
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.Toolt: Zone painted along the roads. Cells that are already zoned keep their zone.
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Control.depth.Tool: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
Placemaker.EdgeZoning.Issue.NoFrontage: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
